Fetch the logs of a backtest for the project Id, backtest Id and lines provided. The /backtests/read/log API accepts requests in the following format:

ReadBacktestLogsRequest Model - Request to read logs from a backtest.
projectId integer
required
example: 23456789
Id of the project from which to read the backtest.
backtestId string
required
example: 26c7bb06b8487cff1c7b3c44652b30f1
Id of the backtest from which to read the logs.
start integer
required
example: 0
Start line (inclusive) of logs to read. The lines numbers start at 0.
end integer
required
example: 200
End line (exclusive) of logs to read, where end - start <= 200.
query string
required
example: error
Case-insensitive keyword to filter the log lines. The start and end lines index the lines that contain the keyword. To read all the lines, set it to null or an empty string.
Example 
{
  "projectId": 23456789,
  "backtestId": "26c7bb06b8487cff1c7b3c44652b30f1",
  "start": 0,
  "end": 200,
  "query": "error"
}
